description: Source code defining classes and methods for managing Red Hat Subscription Manager (RHSM) commands within a kickstart configuration, including support for RHEL8 and RHEL10.

classes.name: RHEL8_RHSM
classes.description: Class representing RHSM command configuration for RHEL8, with options for organization, activation keys, proxy, server hostname, and base URL.

classes.name: RHEL10_RHSM
classes.description: Subclass of RHEL8_RHSM adding support for flatpak registry URL for RHEL10.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing RHSM command with optional parameters.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the RHSM command with configured options.

methods.name: _has_options
methods.description: Checks if any options are set for the RHSM command.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser for the RHSM command.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and sets class attributes accordingly.
